name: Rules They Abide By
source:
Straight-laced Misao Suzuhara is new to her teaching career. Fresh from a University in Tokyo, she lands a home room role for a class of third-year high school students in rural Gunma prefecture. But Misao's bland and carefully-planned life takes a turn for the unexpected when she piques the interest of a mysterious and underachieving student bent on teaching her some real life experiences of his own.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=37532]Lemma Soft Forums]]
translation:
循规蹈矩的铃原美纱刚开始教师生涯。她刚从东京大学毕业，就在群马县乡下的一所高中担任高三班主任。然而，当一名神秘、成绩不佳的学生对她产生兴趣，并决心教她一些真正的人生经验时，美纱平淡且精心规划的生活突然转向意外。

[来源：[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=37532]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
